verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes extensive documented API surfaces for agent-driven use: ACS for-sellers/for-agents docs, custom checkout reverse-API spec, shared payment token concepts, an official MCP server, Link CLI, machine payments (x402/MPP) protocols, restricted API keys guidance for agents, and an anonymous sandbox provisioning flow for coding agents. Probes confirm live docs.md/llms.txt endpoints and a documented MCP server, reinforcing these are real, reachable API surfaces. Missing for 10: an official OpenAPI/swagger spec discoverable at a standard path (probe found 404s), and independent hands-on confirmation resolving community complaints that some flows (e.g., SPT/MPP end-to-end semantics) are documented sparsely.
